deployments_detail.use: AI-powered intelligent customer service, moving from standardized responses to personalized interactions — cited by the chairman as one of the deployed 'basic, universal, error-tolerant' AI scenarios. [East Money (Miaoxiang-based)]
Self-developed "妙想" (Miaoxiang) financial LLM; AI investment assistant; "首个基于金融大模型的智能应用"; AI integrated across all product/business lines

Miaoxiang (妙想) self-developed financial large language model, opened to all users and fully deployed on the East Money APP as a consumer AI investment assistant (real-time quote/K-line analysis, news interpretation, source-traceable Q&A). One of the first financial LLMs to pass China CAC (网信办) filing in 2023. [East Money (self-developed / 自研)]

Miaoxiang Investment Research Assistant (妙想投研助理) — next-generation intelligent financial terminal for institutions, with multi-agent collaboration and reasoning. Widely adapted to brokerage, fund and bank research workflows. [East Money (self-developed)]

Choice intelligent financial terminal (v8.0) seven AI scenarios: AI search, AI Q&A, AI research-report summary, AI document assistant, AI news summary, AI bond news, and AI bond trading assistant — DATA+AI across PC/APP for investment research professionals. [East Money (self-developed)]
Localized on-premise deployment and testing of the DeepSeek large model, with Miaoxiang financial LLM upgraded to a 'deep thinking' (深度思考) reasoning mode. [DeepSeek]

Intelligent research report generation (智能研报 / AI研究员 'AI researcher') within Miaoxiang: summarizes multiple research reports, generates core-view briefs, and one-click drafts various reports for analysts. [East Money (self-developed)]

Intelligent meeting (智能会议) module within Miaoxiang: automatic transcription of roadshow/meeting content, multilingual translation, and auto-summarization of key metrics — a back-office productivity function. [East Money (self-developed)]

Miaoxiang Skills (妙想Skills) — financial AI skill packages exposing six institutional research scenarios (intelligent stock screening, macro data insights, financial data queries, financial news penetration, quantitative API, Miaoxiang Q&A) via a built-in institutional-grade MCP financial database, callable by external/general LLM agents. [East Money (self-developed); MCP]

AI applied to marketing and office/back-office scenarios — described by the chairman as relatively basic, universal, error-tolerant scenarios where large models are already deployed. [East Money (Miaoxiang-based)]

AI risk management: sentiment monitoring and real-time surveillance able to identify abnormal trading patterns and compliance risks in advance, shifting risk control from post-event analysis to early warning. [East Money (Miaoxiang-based)]
